messages:
maya_support: Escalation from Glimmer (acct glimmer-prod). Starting ~03:07 UTC they see 502/504s and 'TLS handshake timeout' when hitting /v1/chat/completions on api.eu-west.redwood.ai. Customer opened INF-2986 and provided request ids req-7761, req-7762.

alex_m: Thx. Can you paste a minimal repro curl and the exact host/region? Also any curl error codes they saw?

maya_support: Host: api.eu-west.redwood.ai (eu-west-1). Repro they ran (behind corporate proxy):

``` 
curl -v "https://api.eu-west.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}], "max_tokens":8}'
```

They see the TLS handshake hang then curl returns 56 / 'recv() failed' and our edge returns HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway.

luis_infra: pulling gateway metrics now. I see spike in upstream TLS handshake timeouts at 03:05:30 UTC, lasting about 10-12 minutes. Sample from edge log (redacted):

```
[03:06:01] proxy: upstream handshake timeout while connecting to 10.4.10.7:443, client 203.0.113.42, request "POST /v1/chat/completions"
[03:06:27] proxy: connection reset after TLS handshake from 10.4.10.12
[03:06:59] proxy: upstream handshake timeout to 10.4.10.7:443
```

sarah_ops: running DNS traces. Noticed brief period where internal resolvers returned mixed A records for api.eu-west.redwood.ai — some nodes pointing at new backend IPs, others to old. TTL for record was low (30s) due to recent deploy. Also saw Route53 health checks flap for the backend target group between 03:04-03:08 UTC. If traffic concentrated on backends that had just pulled a new cert bundle missing the intermediate, we'd see handshake failures.

maya_support: Customer ran openssl s_client with SNI and reported incomplete chain / verify errors:

```
openssl s_client -connect api.eu-west.redwood.ai:443 -servername api.eu-west.redwood.ai -showcerts
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = api.eu-west.redwood.ai
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
...leaf cert...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
```

They said some clients (python requests) failed consistently while modern browsers intermittently worked — matches mixed-node behavior.

luis_infra: looking at cert-rotation logs. Rotation started 03:03:50 UTC. We have an edge-store upload timeout at 03:04:02 (PUT timed out), job retried and eventually reported success at 03:05:10. Hypothesis: some nodes pulled the new bundle early which was malformed (missing intermediate) due to a packaging bug, others still had the old bundle. Combined with DNS churn and health-check traffic concentration -> intermittent 502s.

deploy-bot: cert-rotation/eu-west-1 job: PUT edge-store timed out at 03:04:02; retry succeeded at 03:05:10 (final status: succeeded).

alex_m: please run openssl s_client directly against an affected node IP (SNI) to inspect chain. If server returns incomplete chain, some TLS clients will abort while others may tolerate it. Also check gateway logs for 'upstream handshake timeout' spikes and correlate with cert rotation timestamps.

maya_support: I ran s_client from their network and got the incomplete chain (see above). Also they captured tcpdump showing TLS ClientHello followed by no ServerHello on ~40% of sessions.

sarah_ops: DNS timeline: we pushed a low TTL change to speed cutover in the deploy; combined with Route53 health-check flapping (targets cycling due to rotation), resolver caches distributed traffic unevenly. A node subset was disproportionately chosen and those nodes had the malformed cert.

luis_infra: mitigation actions taken immediately:
- Rollback cert bundle to previous known-good across eu-west gateways
- Drain + restart gateway pods that logged TLS errors to clear any cached upstreams
- Temporarily increase Route53 health-check grace to reduce flapping during rotations

ops-bot: triggered rollback to cert-bundle v2026-02-14-rollback on gateways eu-west-1 (initiated by luis_infra). Rolling restart in progress.

luis_infra: rollback completed across 8 pods at ~03:18 UTC. Verified with openssl s_client on several nodes: full chain present, verification OK. Sampled the customer's request ids: req-7761 now shows 200 at 03:20 UTC.

maya_support: Glimmer confirmed errors cleared after ~03:20 UTC and requested RCA + account credit. Assigned INF-2986->owner: alex_m (postmortem), luis_infra (rotation fix), sarah_ops (dns/hc smoothing), maya_support (customer comms).

alex_m: Post-incident action items (owners):
- luis_infra: fix edge-store upload retry/backoff and add pre-rotation validation that cert bundle includes full chain (unit+integration test)
- luis_infra: add atomic swap semantics to avoid nodes seeing partial bundles (or use canary + progressive rollout)
- sarah_ops: add health-check smoothing policy tied to cert rotation windows and implement canary routing to small subset during cert swaps
- devex: add automated cert-chain validation (openssl verify) in CI for packaging pipeline
- maya_support: draft customer-facing timeline and credit proposal
- monitoring: add alert on "upstream handshake timeout" percentage > threshold over 1m and auto-drain affected upstreams

sarah_ops: root cause summary: packaging bug omitted intermediate cert in one cert bundle build combined with edge-store upload timeout/retry window -> partial propagation of malformed bundle. DNS/Route53 health-check churn concentrated traffic to bad nodes -> observed handshake timeouts and 502s.

maya_support: customer accepted the small credit and asked for the postmortem. I'll send once alex_m publishes it. Holding INF-2986 open until PRs merged.

alex_m: I'll write the incident postmortem and include timeline, logs, and remediation PR links. Recommend we add a canary gating step to rotations and enforce cert chain verification before marking rotation success.

luis_infra: added PR to edge-store client to increase PUT timeout and exponential backoff; added preflight cert-chain check.

sarah_ops: added Route53 smoothing change and a playbook note for cert rotation windows.

maya_support: closing loop with Glimmer; they acknowledged receipt of the proposed RCA and timeline. :white_check_mark:
